reason: Schedule and feasibility lens. The calendar alone could fit: if every stage passes on the first try, a probe could be scored between 26 Sep ~22:00 and 27 Sep ~03:00 UTC. The idea fails on the probability of reaching a scored, gate-passing probe before 29 Sep 10:00 UTC. That is ~0.03-0.05 with the idea's own pre-registered gates, and ~0.4 with no gates, both far below 0.70. Checked facts: (1) The DATASET DOES NOT EXIST AND ITS WRITER DOES NOT EXIST. tools/dorado_clips.py (idea 1's Kaggle-format clip + geff writer) is not in the repo. The only dorado dataset, vitaliineibauer/biohub-dorado-crops, holds 5x16x32x32 DaughterNet crops (tools/dorado_crops.py), not full volumes with Ultrack edges. The dataset therefore needs about 2-3 h of agent code plus a parity test, then the user's Colab session to stream 25-40 GB from public.czbiohub.org (logged 2-10 MB/s = 1-5 h) and upload ~4 GB with a Kaggle token. The user is in MSK, so this means the evening of 25 Sep. The idea's '26 Sep 02:00 fine-tune' assumes a push at 05:00 MSK, but the realistic first push is ~07:00 UTC. (2) HARD CHAINED GATES. The idea says it should run only after idea 1's OOS gate passes; idea 1 was refuted on value, and the sibling estimate for a comparable dense gate is P ~0.15-0.35. Then its own OOS gate (a) (P ~0.5, guess) and the head kill test (b) (P ~0.4-0.5). Every earlier cross-embryo head refit lost to the public head: out_full_P/Q 6bba->44b6 1.452/1.378 vs 1.296 um. (3) NOT IMPLEMENTABLE AS DESCRIBED WITH EXISTING TOOLS, which adds ~5-7 h of agent work that no probe has exercised. (a) tools/build_probe_kernel.py --base x138 supports only divinsert|leafprune. PRIMARY_OVERRIDE lives only in exp39/exp48-lineage notebooks: x138 has no such knob (ext_x138/DIFF.md l.74, 92). A new x138 cell-3/4/5 'primary+head' patch with byte-identity tests is needed, including the primary load in both GPU-shard predict subprocesses. (b) The capture builder is exp51-based (exp48 stack, not x138). It asserts the public head dataset, and local_capture.py hardcodes PRIMARY_SHA 12f6881e (l.56), so a --primary knob plus a weights dataset is needed. (c) train_unet_transformer.py takes a single --data-dir (l.1207-1248), so mixing read-only competition train with dorado clips at 1:1 needs a symlink farm plus a sampler/splits patch. (d) 'x138's 20 movies' are x107's capture (DIFF.md l.24); ours are a heuristic (train_coordhead.py x138_probable_train l.197). (e) Sanity (c), 'the 6bba in-sample check with the official metric on the x138 stack', has no harness: the x138 lab cache is friend A's pending job, and he has made no commits since 24 Sep 04:12 MSK. (4) THE BASE IS PENDING: #34 (x138 verbatim) scores 25 Sep 17:00-20:00. If #34 < 0.953 (P ~0.15, guess), --base x138 has no host. (5) RESOURCE CONFLICT. The GPU-h fit easily in vitalii's 30/week: fine-tune ~1-2, capture ~0.7-1.2, OOS inference ~1, dummy ~0.7. But these compete with idea 1 (same dataset, same morning) and the other lines for 2 concurrent sessions and 5 slots/day. sasyami needs friend A to push, and his availability is uncertain. (6) Even if scored, one probe swaps the primary, the edge net, the head and the threshold at once, against 0.003-0.004 LB noise. Chain: P(dataset ready by 26 Sep 07:00) 0.6 x P(x138 base) 0.85 x P(idea-1 gate) 0.33 x P(gate a) 0.5 x P(gate b) 0.5 x P(no slip in 4 GPU stages + a new patch) 0.8 ~= 0.034. Without gates: 0.6 x 0.85 x 0.8 ~= 0.41.
fix_if_any: No repair reaches P >= 0.7 by 29 Sep 10:00, because the gates are the binding constraint, not the clock. The best schedule-repaired variant: (1) Today, 25 Sep 11:30-18:00 in this container, pre-write ALL glue: tools/dorado_clips.py with a synthetic parity test, a data-dir symlink farm + 1:1 sampler patch in experiments/_lib/train_patches.py, --primary for build_capture_kernel.py/local_capture.py, and a --base x138 'primaryhead' patch (PRIMARY_WEIGHTS + COORDHEAD_HEAD_PATH, exact no-op when off, byte-identity test vs exp56). (2) The user streams dorado on Colab on the evening of 25 Sep and uploads it (only if #34 = 0.953). (3) 26 Sep ~07:00 UTC: push idea 1's secondary fine-tune and this primary fine-tune IN PARALLEL on vitalii's two sessions. This removes the serial dependency at a cost of ~2 GPU-h if idea 1 fails. Both OOS dorado inferences run inside the same kernels (held-out block + 20 6bba videos for N_pred), done ~10:00. (4) If gate (a) passes: 20-movie capture ~10:30-12:00. Run the head refit + kill test on CPU against an OLD-feature 20-movie refit, from the existing 199 captures restricted to those 20 npz, ~12:30. The CPU pre-kill on the old captures can and should run TODAY: if an old-feature 20-movie refit cannot match the public head cross-embryo, drop the head half and the idea. (5) Package the weights + head as a dataset, build, dummy run ~13:00-14:30, submit ~15:00 26 Sep with the user's OK, scored ~27 Sep 00:00. This gives ~2 days of slack, but P(scored) stays ~0.05-0.08 through the gates. Run it only as a post-deadline research line or as a gated long shot that must not block idea 1 or the finals.
